line: Found a little pack in a drawer by the door
Plastic stars I bought at a corner store
Stood on my bed with my arms stretched high
Made my own ceiling into a sky
Lights go off and the room goes blue
And a hundred little stars come through
Glow-in-the-dark stars over my bed
Brighter than the worries running through my head
Not quite the real ones, but they shine just right
My little galaxy every night
Made a constellation shaped like a cat
One like a coffee cup, one like a hat
Nobody else gets to see them glow
Just me and the hum of the radio
Lights go off and the room goes blue
And a hundred little stars come through
Glow-in-the-dark stars over my bed
Brighter than the worries running through my head
Not quite the real ones, but they shine just right
My little galaxy every night
Don't need a telescope
Don't need to go too far
Sometimes the sweetest sky
Is right here where you are
Glow-in-the-dark stars over my bed
Brighter than the worries running through my head
Not quite the real ones, but they shine just right
My little galaxy every night
Little galaxy
Goodnight
